summary:
LUNAR EDGE is an intelligent lunar mission-analysis platform designed to support safer and more resilient landing operations near the Moon's South Pole. It goes beyond conventional landing-site selection by evaluating how changing mission conditions can affect the feasibility and safety of a lunar landing.

Our platform combines real NASA Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) elevation data with terrain analysis, sunlight continuity, Earth visibility, communication constraints, and landing parameters to assess potential landing opportunities.

**Our key innovation is Counterfactual Mission Recovery Intelligence.** Instead of simply identifying suitable landing locations, LUNAR EDGE explores what happens when mission conditions change, identifies the constraints threatening mission success, and evaluates alternative recovery possibilities. It also incorporates Monte Carlo-based uncertainty analysis to account for variations in landing position and timing.

Unlike static landing-site ranking tools, LUNAR EDGE approaches lunar exploration as a dynamic decision-making problem. Its goal is to help mission planners understand not only where a spacecraft could land, but also how to respond when the original landing plan becomes unsafe or infeasible.

By combining terrain intelligence, mission constraints, uncertainty analysis, and recovery-oriented decision support, LUNAR EDGE aims to make future lunar missions safer, more adaptable, and more resilient.
details:
What Does LUNAR EDGE Do?

LUNAR EDGE is an intelligent lunar mission-analysis and decision-support platform designed to make lunar landings safer and more resilient, particularly in the challenging lunar South Polar region.

Three Core Innovations

1. Autonomous Landing Opportunity Discovery

  • Goes beyond predefined landing-site selection.
  • Identifies potential landing opportunities using lunar terrain and mission constraints.
  • Combines elevation, illumination, and visibility analysis to assess landing feasibility.

2. Probabilistic Mission Resilience

  • Evaluates how reliable a landing opportunity remains under uncertain conditions.
  • Uses Monte Carlo simulation to explore variations in landing position and timing.
  • Assesses whether a mission can tolerate deviations from its ideal conditions.

3. Counterfactual Mission Recovery Intelligence

  • Investigates what happens when the original landing plan becomes unsafe or infeasible.
  • Diagnoses failed mission constraints.
  • Explores alternative conditions and recovery recommendations instead of simply rejecting the landing opportunity.

Technology and Implementation

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Scientific Data: NASA LOLA lunar elevation data
  • Analysis: Terrain assessment, illumination and visibility constraints, Monte Carlo simulation
  • Visualization: Interactive 3D lunar South Pole environment

Benefits and Intended Impact

  • Supports more informed lunar landing decisions.
  • Helps identify potential mission risks before landing.
  • Introduces uncertainty-aware mission assessment.
  • Provides recovery-oriented decision support when conditions change.
  • Supports safer and more adaptable future robotic and human lunar exploration.

What Makes LUNAR EDGE Different?

Instead of treating lunar landing as a one-time site-selection problem, LUNAR EDGE connects three critical stages: discovering landing opportunities, evaluating their resilience, and finding ways to recover when mission conditions fail.

Our Vision

To move lunar exploration beyond landing-site selection towards autonomous, uncertainty-aware mission intelligence — where every landing opportunity is evaluated, every uncertainty is challenged, and every failure becomes an opportunity to find a safer path forward.
